Find the sum of the first N natural numbers (loop and formula).

Supplied answer
n = int(input("Enter N: "))
total = 0
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    total += i
print("Sum using loop =", total)
print("Sum using formula =", n * (n + 1) // 2)
Note: The formula n(n+1)/2 answers it in O(1) time - mention this in an interview.
